dataset.name: Lap-NET1 locally advanced pancreatic-cancer cohort (GSE319924)
dataset.description: Prospective locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cohort with pretreatment laser-capture microdissected tumor-cell microbulk RNA-seq and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Lap-NET1 was a prospective single-arm phase 1b trial of first-line NP137 plus mFOLFIRINOX in 43 patients with locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Fine-needle aspirates were collected from 32 patients regardless of clinical outcome. TRACE Explorer retains the 22 pretreatment tumor-compartment libraries that passed the source study's sequencing QC and excludes stromal, post-treatment, surgical and technical-repeat libraries.

metadata.library_method: SMART-Seq mRNA LP whole-transcriptome sequencing from laser-capture microdissected pretreatment tumor cells; 100-bp paired-end reads
metadata.treatment_context: All retained patients received first-line NP137 plus mFOLFIRINOX; associations are treatment-context specific and are not directly transportable to untreated or resected whole-tissue cohorts.
metadata.sample_selection_note: GEO exposes 23 pretreatment tumor-compartment libraries. S025T1R1 is excluded because the source analysis code identifies it as a failed low-depth library with 1,072 reads, reconciling the GEO inventory with the 22 QC-valid pretreatment profiles reported in the article.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: Only the deidentified participant identifier and OS time/status fields published in the pinned GEO family SOFT are used. Demographic fields from the companion code repository are intentionally not imported.
metadata.overlap_note: This prospective French trial cohort is independent of TCGA-PAAD and of the other external pancreatic-cancer releases in TRACE Explorer.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Redistribution of source or derived expression matrices remains disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.
metadata.curation_note: The 22 endpoint-complete patients contain 11 deaths and 11 censored observations. Library sizes are calculated over all 28,395 pinned source rows before log2(CPM + 1). A pinned NCBI Homo sapiens gene_info snapshot maps 27,769 Entrez rows to 27,769 unique symbols; 626 unmapped rows remain part of the library-size denominator but are excluded from the analyzable matrix.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment laser-capture microdissected pancreatic tumor-cell microbulk

expression.label: GEO counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned NCBI Homo sapiens gene_info snapshot downloaded 2026-07-28
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The pinned reference maps each retained Entrez row to a unique HUGO-style symbol; no source rows are combined.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes each retained sample library size across all 28,395 pinned source rows, converts counts to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). The final analyzable matrix retains 27,769 uniquely mapped symbols. Values are cohort-normalized and should not be compared directly with expression units from other releases.
